# Data Exploration and Assessing Assumptions

### 1. Data Structure and Initial Inspection

Understanding the dataset before conducting any analysis.

\begin{itemize}
\item Dataset dimensions (rows and columns)
\item Variable types (numeric, categorical, ordinal, date/time)
\item Continuous vs. discrete variables
\item Identifying unique observations and duplicate records
\item Identifying unique values and categories
\item Data types and class conversion
\item Data consistency and formatting
\item Identifying invalid or impossible values
\item Data validation and integrity checks
\end{itemize}

R functions: str(), glimpse(), summary(), head(), dim(), nrow(), ncol(), unique(), table()

### 2. Descriptive Statistics and Summary Measures

Summarizing the characteristics and distribution of variables.

\begin{itemize}
\item Mean, median, and mode
\item Minimum and maximum
\item Range
\item Variance and standard deviation
\item Interquartile range (IQR)
\item Quartiles and percentiles
\item Coefficient of variation
\item Skewness
\item Kurtosis
\item Five-number summary
\item Grouped summary statistics
\item Weighted descriptive statistics
\end{itemize}

#### 2.1 Measures of Central Tendency

Measures used to identify the center or typical value of a dataset.

\begin{itemize}
    \item \texttt{mean()} -- Arithmetic mean
    \item \texttt{median()} -- Median
    \item \texttt{Mode()} -- Mode (from \texttt{DescTools}; base R does not have a built-in statistical mode function)
    \item \texttt{weighted.mean()} -- Weighted mean
    \item \texttt{Hmisc::wtd.mean()} -- Weighted mean with additional options
    \item \texttt{DescTools::Mode()} -- Statistical mode
\end{itemize}

#### 2.2 Measures of Variability and Dispersion

Measures used to quantify the spread or variability of observations.

\begin{itemize}
    \item \texttt{var()} -- Variance
    \item \texttt{sd()} -- Standard deviation
    \item \texttt{IQR()} -- Interquartile range
    \item \texttt{range()} -- Minimum and maximum
    \item \texttt{diff(range())} -- Range width
    \item \texttt{mad()} -- Median absolute deviation
    \item \texttt{DescTools::Var()} -- Variance
    \item \texttt{DescTools::CoefVar()} -- Coefficient of variation
    \item \texttt{matrixStats::rowVars()} -- Row-wise variance
    \item \texttt{matrixStats::colVars()} -- Column-wise variance
\end{itemize}

#### 2.3 Measures of Position and Distribution

Measures used to describe the relative position and distribution of observations.

\begin{itemize}
    \item \texttt{min()} -- Minimum
    \item \texttt{max()} -- Maximum
    \item \texttt{quantile()} -- Quantiles
    \item \texttt{rank()} -- Observation ranks
    \item \texttt{scale()} -- Standardization
    \item \texttt{ecdf()} -- Empirical cumulative distribution function
    \item \texttt{summary()} -- Summary statistics
    \item \texttt{fivenum()} -- Five-number summary
    \item \texttt{Hmisc::describe()} -- Detailed descriptive statistics
    \item \texttt{psych::describe()} -- Comprehensive descriptive statistics
\end{itemize}

#### 2.4 Shape of Distribution

Measures used to describe the shape and characteristics of a distribution.

\begin{itemize}
    \item \texttt{e1071::skewness()} -- Skewness
    \item \texttt{moments::skewness()} -- Skewness
    \item \texttt{e1071::kurtosis()} -- Kurtosis
    \item \texttt{moments::kurtosis()} -- Kurtosis
    \item \texttt{PerformanceAnalytics::skewness()} -- Skewness
    \item \texttt{PerformanceAnalytics::kurtosis()} -- Kurtosis
\end{itemize}

\textit{Note: Different packages can use different conventions for calculating skewness and kurtosis, so be mindful of the definitions.}

#### 2.5 Frequency and Categorical Summaries

Functions used to summarize categorical variables and frequency distributions.

\begin{itemize}
    \item \texttt{table()} -- Frequency counts
    \item \texttt{prop.table()} -- Proportions
    \item \texttt{margin.table()} -- Marginal frequencies
    \item \texttt{addmargins()} -- Add row and column totals
    \item \texttt{xtabs()} -- Cross-tabulation
    \item \texttt{janitor::tabyl()} -- Tidy frequency tables
    \item \texttt{janitor::adorn\_totals()} -- Add totals to frequency tables
    \item \texttt{dplyr::count()} -- Count observations by group
\end{itemize}

#### 2.6 Grouped and Advanced Summaries

Functions used to calculate descriptive statistics across groups, columns, or other subsets of data.

\begin{itemize}
    \item \texttt{dplyr::summarise()} -- Calculate summary statistics
    \item \texttt{dplyr::group\_by()} -- Group observations
    \item \texttt{dplyr::across()} -- Apply functions across multiple columns
    \item \texttt{aggregate()} -- Grouped summary statistics
    \item \texttt{by()} -- Apply functions to subsets
    \item \texttt{tapply()} -- Apply functions by groups
    \item \texttt{vapply()} -- Type-safe vectorized application
    \item \texttt{purrr::map()} -- Apply functions across objects
    \item \texttt{data.table::.(...)} -- Efficient grouped calculations with \texttt{data.table}
\end{itemize}

#### 2.7 Additional Useful Packages

Packages that provide additional functionality for descriptive statistics and summary analysis.

\begin{center}
\begin{tabular}{ll}
\hline
\textbf{Package} & \textbf{Main Purpose} \\
\hline
\texttt{psych} & Comprehensive descriptive statistics \\
\texttt{DescTools} & Statistical summaries and descriptive measures \\
\texttt{Hmisc} & Descriptive statistics and weighted summaries \\
\texttt{skimr} & Quick, readable dataset summaries \\
\texttt{summarytools} & Detailed descriptive reports \\
\texttt{janitor} & Frequency tables and data cleaning \\
\texttt{moments} & Skewness and kurtosis \\
\texttt{e1071} & Statistical moments and other statistical tools \\
\texttt{matrixStats} & Efficient row/column statistics \\
\texttt{dplyr} & Grouped and flexible summaries \\
\hline
\end{tabular}
\end{center}

#### 2.8 Recommended R Functions Reference

The following is a consolidated list of useful R functions for descriptive statistics.

\begin{verbatim}
# Central tendency
mean()
median()
weighted.mean()
DescTools::Mode()

# Dispersion
var()
sd()
IQR()
mad()
range()
min()
max()
DescTools::CoefVar()

# Position and distribution
quantile()
rank()
fivenum()
summary()
psych::describe()
skimr::skim()

# Distribution shape
moments::skewness()
moments::kurtosis()

# Frequency and categorical summaries
table()
prop.table()
xtabs()
addmargins()
janitor::tabyl()

# Grouped summaries
dplyr::group_by()
dplyr::summarise()
dplyr::across()
aggregate()
tapply()

# Weighted summaries
weighted.mean()
Hmisc::wtd.mean()
\end{verbatim}
